title: Unified D4 BP-MWPM flux-curve analysis
purpose: Combine every valid current D4 X-only flux-recovery run into one provenance-preserving finite-size data product and threshold analysis after R6Y completes.

included_sources.role: lower-p_X context; generic recurrence; include in pooled primary cells only after output-equivalence audit

exclusions: terminal histories in the conditional flux denominator
pooling_rule: Pool independent histories only by identical (L, p_X, policy, p_Z=0, X-only D4 channel, first-stage Boolean-union flux score, BP schedule). Preserve per-source counts and raw rows. Never replace a point with a later run; sum failure and eligible-history counts after compatibility checks.

matched: Appendix-C paper-normalized periodic honeycomb: 6L^2 blue/green vertices and 9L^2 red-qubit edges
D4 intermediate Abelian fusion-record support/parity likelihood
first-stage public flux and fusion record
not_matched: paper's full sequential post-flux charge-recovery stage
any nonzero p_Z or arbitrary-Pauli noise
paper-model-audit.interpretation: The pooled result is a same-code/same-first-stage-channel BP-MWPM flux-threshold estimate, not a direct replacement for the published full end-to-end p_c=0.20842(2).

outputs: per-source and pooled LER tables with Wilson intervals
finite-size crossing estimate with stated method and uncertainty
40-vs-160 BP stability analysis at the selected crossing neighborhood
claim_boundary: The unified product estimates the D4 X-only first-stage flux threshold for the registered finite-iterate BP->MWPM decoder only; it is not a Lab 003 equivalence claim or the paper's full two-stage threshold.
